comment: The nemar-cli commit whose Tapis client (backend/src/services/tapis/) the application and system definitions in deploy/tapis are tested against: the client's own constants and request shape are read at this commit (tests/deploy/test_tapis_client_agreement.py). It is a commit of nemar-cli's compute epic branch (the launch specification's wire form, A1c). Bump it deliberately, with the test, when the client's request changes. CI checks out exactly this commit.
